The '''M-Class Imperial Attack Transport''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which saw service in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''[[Regina Cayli]]'' was a known M-Class Imperial Attack Transport.

==Characteristics==
The M-Class Imperial Attack Transport was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] class employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of at least two decks; the Transport Deck was located at the bottom of the vessel, and contained a cargo bay with enough room to store two [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. A security console was situated in the cargo bay, with access to the ship's layout and information. Incorrectly accessing the console would result in an internal alarm sounding throughout the ship. The Command Deck was located above the Transport Deck, and was the location of the ship's [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], in room B12. The infirmary was equipped with at least one pallet, a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], and was staffed by a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. A security code was required to access the room. Travel between the decks was via a [[grav tube]], where local [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] could be manipulated by [[microgravity]] controls to float individuals between decks. The M-Class Imperial Attack Transport also featured [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|ports]], and the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] were located on the top of the vessel.<ref name="Regina" />

==Role==
The M-Class Imperial Attack Transport was used as troop transport by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Its typical complement included at least two squads of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Regina" />

==History==
M-Class Imperial Attack Transports were active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''[[Regina Cayli]]'' was present at [[New Bakstre]] when [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] forced down the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was making an unscheduled delivery to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The ''Regina Cayli'' landed near the crash site and investigated the scene, taking one of the freighter's crew, the injured [[Hawk Carrow]], prisoner. Carrow's partner, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], subsequently infiltrated the ''Regina Cayli'' and rescued his friend.<ref name="Regina" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M-Class Imperial Attack Transport was featured in the roleplaying adventure "[[Regina Cayli (adventure)|Regina Cayli]]," first published in [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] by [[West End Games]] in [[1987]]. It was subsequently reprinted in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[1994]].
